title: Construction of a Family of Quantum Codes Using Sub-exceding Functions via the Hypergraph Product and the Generalized Shor Construction
summary: In this paper, we introduce a new family of stabilizer quantum LDPC codes derived from the classical linear codes $L_k$ and $L_k^{+}$, defined via sub-exceding functions. In previous work, these codes demonstrated strong performance in minimum distance, decoding efficiency, and structural simplicity. By combining the hypergraph product framework with a generalized Shor construction, we obtain a scalable class of quantum codes with parameters $[[6k^2,\, k^2,\, d]]$.
